capabilities: Reveal files that Obsidian forcefully hides, including dotfiles
Toggle visibility of hidden files on and off
Exclude specific files or folders such as .git and .venv in settings
Interact with unhidden files like normal vault files
extras: The README warns of serious risks: enabling the plugin with large dot-folders can freeze Obsidian, and in vaults using Obsidian Sync it can permanently delete hidden files on all synced devices; the author states 'Do not use this plugin if your data is very important.' It also requires enabling Files & links > Detect all file extensions and warns other plugins may misinterpret exposed hidden files.
problem: Obsidian forcibly hides files like dotfiles, so vault content in dot-directories (e.g. attachment folders) is invisible and uneditable.

relations.evidence: When the vault base is synced with Nextcloud, this lets embedded images display in both Obsidian and Nextcloud Notes.
Using this plugin in a vault with Obsidian Sync can permanently delete hidden files on all your synced devices.

summary: File-visibility plugin that reveals hidden files, such as dotfiles and dot-folders, in the vault and lets you interact with them like normal files.
